question: What is this process called when the mixture in the mixture settles down after adding it to the water?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Sedimentation.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• When the **heavier component** in a **mixture settles** after **water is added** to it, the process is called **sedimentation.**
 
• When the water (along with the dust) is removed, the process is called decanta
